title: A-Eye system map
measured_note: Measured on real Gemini Live calls on 2026-10-25 with synthetic speech. Anything else says not measured.
cost_note: Costs are estimates from the server's own meter defaults, not provider invoices. One 2.5 minute Live call with Rewind measured about $1.40 on the meter; the meter overcounts status polls. Local models cost $0.

nodes.name: Camera + mic
nodes.what: The phone or browser streams microphone audio and one camera frame per second, downscaled to 320 px, over one WebSocket. It plays the voice reply and draws boxes on the live view.

nodes.name: A-Eye server /ws2
nodes.what: One socket per call. It fans each turn out to the router, the safety gates, the step guide, vision and memory, and relays Gemini's voice back. Code decides what is safe and which step is next; models only phrase and look.

nodes.name: Gemini Live talker
nodes.what: Hears the voice and sees 1 fps frames, then speaks. It is the only voice in the normal call. Safety gates can mute it mid sentence and speak a fixed line instead.
facts: End of speech to first voice

look.title: Measured response times
look.foot: Measured on real Live calls tonight, synthetic speech.

nodes.building: Time scope (just now / earlier this call / earlier calls) is being built tonight.
nodes.name: Router
nodes.what: Embeds each question and picks a lane in about 43 ms: answer from now (camera), from the past (memory) or ask the expert. Small and local, so it never waits on the cloud.

nodes.name: Safety gates
nodes.what: Plain code, no model. A question about a known hazard gets a fixed line and no model is asked. A reply that calls a hazard fine is replaced. On a hazard it mutes Gemini and speaks the stop line 86 ms after speech ends.
facts: a local model once told a user heavily smoking oil was fine

look.title: After the user stops speaking
look.foot: The gate speaks first, so the model never gets to say the unsafe thing.

nodes.name: Step guide
nodes.what: Code owns the task and the current step; Gemini only phrases it. A step moves only when the guide's rules pass. The shutoff step also needs the valve checker to see the valve off in the current frame: saying "it's off" is refused.
facts: refuses spoken "it's off" without a frame that shows it
fixed lines from code, phrased by Live

cards.head: Guide asks the valve checker
cards.body: Current frame only, Qwen 2.5-VL on the home GPU.

cards.head: No proof in the frame
cards.body: Step stays. Fixed retry line is spoken.

nodes.name: Context builder
nodes.what: Every ~4 seconds in the background it writes a short scene note from the transcript and recent frames and hands it to Gemini, so answers know what happened. With Claude switched off it falls back to a local model.
facts: $5 / M input, $25 / M output, $0.5 / M cache read (cloud_meter.py defaults, budget weights not an invoice)

nodes.name: Grounding boxes
nodes.what: When you name an object it finds it in the frame and returns a box, drawn on your screen about 1.8 to 2.3 s after the object is named.

look.title: Object named to box on screen

nodes.name: Captions + valve check
nodes.what: Writes short captions of frames for memory and runs the trusted valve checker the step guide relies on.

nodes.name: YOLO detector
nodes.what: Fast object detection on frames, served by boxsvc on the GPU box, bound to the tailnet only.

nodes.name: Private mode voice
nodes.what: In Private mode every cloud switch is off: Whisper turns speech into text, a local model answers and Kokoro speaks, all at home.

nodes.name: Recent memory
nodes.what: Remembers what was said and seen in this call so "what did I just do?" can be answered from text, without video. Lives only for the call.
facts: this call, seconds to minutes ago

look.title: Where an answer about the past comes from
look.foot: The router's time scope picks the row. Time scope is being built tonight.

nodes.name: Rewind
nodes.kind: TwelveLabs video search of this call
nodes.what: Short silent clips around busy moments are uploaded to TwelveLabs so you can ask about earlier in the call. Clips are deleted when the call ends.
facts: now 15 s (REWIND_FLUSH_S; code default 60), not re-measured
up to 12 s, at most 60 per call, deleted at call end
TWELVELABS_REQUEST_USD default 0.10 per request, demo override 0.01 (estimate)

look.title: Event to searchable
look.foot: 35 to 40 s was measured before the flush moved to 15 s; not re-measured.

nodes.building: Recall from saved calls into a live call is being built tonight.
nodes.name: Saved calls
nodes.what: With memory consent, a call is saved on this Mac, encrypted on disk when the memory key is set. Pulling it back into a new call is the recall pipeline, still being built.
facts: Fernet encrypted when A_EYE_MEMORY_KEY is set; otherwise file system protection only
this Mac by default (STORE=local); optional SpacetimeDB store encrypts personal fields before upload

look.title: Knowledge cards: what a saved call keeps

cards.head: Encrypted on disk
cards.body: Fernet, when A_EYE_MEMORY_KEY is set. Stays on the Mac by default (STORE=local).

cards.head: Consent first
cards.body: Saved only while memory consent is on.

nodes.name: Parts shelf
nodes.what: 10,001 Amazon tool and electronics listings scraped with Apify by Shivam and stored in the team SpacetimeDB, so A-Eye can suggest a part that fits. Hooking it into the call is being built tonight.
facts: market/compat.py decides in code; unknown spec is unverified

look.title: Parts shelf
look.foot: The cloud of points around this node has one point per listing. Positions are decorative.

nodes.name: Privacy switches
nodes.what: Every cloud path has a named switch checked in code on every server path. Private mode turns them all off and the call runs at home.
facts: all off; Whisper, local brain, Kokoro

look.title: What leaves home, and what turns it off

edges.name: voice + frames
edges.what: Mic audio and 1 fps, 320 px frames up; voice and boxes back down. One WebSocket, /ws2.

edges.name: live audio + frames
edges.what: The live conversation. Gemini hears and sees, then speaks; the reply streams back through the server to the phone.

edges.name: question
edges.what: Each finished question is routed in about 43 ms (p50, held-out set).

edges.name: find an object
edges.what: "Where is the M.2 slot?" goes to grounding; the box is on screen about 1.8 to 2.3 s after the object is named.

edges.name: just now
edges.what: Questions about seconds or minutes ago read recent memory.

edges.name: earlier this call
edges.what: Questions about earlier in this call search Rewind.

edges.name: earlier calls
edges.what: Recall from saved calls. Being built tonight, so no data flows here yet.

edges.name: every transcript
edges.what: Every transcript and every spoken reply passes the gates.

edges.name: mute + stop line
edges.what: On a hazard the gate mutes Gemini and the fixed stop line plays 86 ms after speech ends.

edges.name: transcript + frame
edges.what: The guide checks the user's words against the current step's rules.

edges.name: valve check
edges.what: For the shutoff step the guide asks the trusted valve checker about the current frame.

edges.name: step to phrase
edges.what: The current step goes to Gemini to phrase. Gemini cannot move the step.

edges.name: every ~4 s
edges.what: Every ~4 s the context builder gets the latest transcript and frames.

edges.name: scene note
edges.what: A short written scene note is handed to Gemini.

edges.name: frames to boxes
edges.what: Frames to the YOLO detector over Tailscale.

edges.name: frames to captions
edges.what: Frames to the caption model for memory.

edges.name: Private mode audio
edges.what: In Private mode speech goes to Whisper and the reply comes back as Kokoro voice.

edges.name: turn log
edges.what: Each turn and caption is logged in call-local memory.

edges.name: silent clips
edges.what: Busy moments become short silent clips, uploaded on each flush and searchable about 35 to 40 s after the event.

edges.name: save at call end
edges.what: With memory consent the call is saved, encrypted, at the end.

edges.name: part that fits
edges.what: Part suggestions from the shelf. Being built tonight.

edges.name: Google switch
edges.what: Switch: off means no frames or voice go to Google.

edges.name: Claude switch
edges.what: Switch: off means the context builder runs on a local model.

edges.name: TwelveLabs switch
edges.what: Switch: off means no clips leave the Mac.

flows.name: Ask a question
flows.say: Voice and frames reach the server, the router picks a lane in 43 ms, Gemini answers with the latest scene note. First voice 0.6 to 1.1 s after you stop.

flows.name: Find an object
flows.say: "Where is it?" routes to grounding on the home GPU; the box is on your screen about 1.8 to 2.3 s after you name it.

flows.name: Hazard stop
flows.say: A coded gate catches the hazard, mutes Gemini and plays the stop line 86 ms after you stop speaking.

flows.name: Rewind
flows.say: Silent clips go to TwelveLabs and are searchable about 35 to 40 s later; "what did I do earlier?" routes there.

flows.name: Private mode
flows.say: Every cloud switch off: Whisper, a local model and Kokoro at home. $0, speed not measured.

headline.say: A-Eye sees through your phone camera and talks you through hands-on jobs, while coded safety gates can cut the model off mid sentence.
